free_order3.theorem: Any algebraic automorphism of a genus-one curve of order 3 is translation by a nonzero 3-torsion point of its Jacobian after choosing an origin, provided it is not a group automorphism of (E,O). Group automorphisms of order 3 occur only for j=0.  Here j(E_t)=8192/11≠0, so Aut(E,O)={±1}, and the residual order-3 element ρ ∈ C_G(t)/<t> ≅ S3 acts freely on E_t as translation by a unique nonzero q ∈ E_t[3] (unique up to q ↔ -q = 2q depending on orientation).
